mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 43 degrees at Verona Community Park under clear skies with a first quarter moon. If you are an early bird, the International Space Station will be visible for 4 minutes starting at 5:42 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling high in the sky toward Madison near the Home Depot.

In city news, the Verona Police Department recently responded to an incident on Thursday, October 15, involving a school bus driver arrested for operating while impaired. Additionally, the city reminds residents that they can use the interactive zoning map on the city website to check property districts, and remember to double-check your designated polling location before heading out to vote.

Looking at our calendar, you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, get ready for plenty of trivia options including games at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.

On Thursday, October 15, Verona police officers conducted a traffic stop and arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving. No injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating a potential collision with a traffic sign.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently closed, but it will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
